fields.description: The status slug as WooCommerce has it, for example processing
fields.label: WooCommerce Status

fields.description: What an order that has this status does in ERPNext. With nothing ticked, its Sales Order only takes the status, lines and payment of the order. Hold, Cancel and Close are done once, when the order gets the status, and so is lifting a hold put on the Sales Order, which Submit, Invoice and Deliver do. Invoice and Deliver make what the Sales Order lacks on every sync.
fields.label: When WooCommerce has this status

fields.description: Make the Sales Order of an order first seen with this status, with its Customer, Address and Contact, and submit it. No other action makes one, so without Submit such an order stays out of ERPNext.
fields.label: Submit

fields.description: Make the Sales Invoice of the Sales Order when it has none, if the server creates Sales Invoices
fields.label: Invoice

fields.description: Make the Delivery Note of the Sales Order when nothing of it is delivered, dated when WooCommerce completed the order
fields.label: Deliver

fields.description: Put the Sales Order on hold. With Invoice it is invoiced first, as ERPNext doesn't invoice an order on hold. Not with Deliver, as ERPNext doesn't deliver one either.
fields.label: Hold

fields.description: Cancel the Sales Order and its unpaid Sales Invoices. One that was paid, delivered or billed with other orders is closed and flagged instead. Ticked alone.
fields.label: Cancel

fields.description: Close the Sales Order. Ticked alone.
fields.label: Close

fields.description: Leave the orders with this status out of the hourly sync, as nothing is to be done with them. Ticked alone.
fields.label: Skip

fields.description: Set the WooCommerce Order to this status when the Sales Order reaches this status
fields.label: Push on
fields.options:
Draft
On Hold
To Deliver and Bill
To Bill
